status: PREIMPLEMENTATION_EXEMPLAR — not runtime authority; the bound catalog prevails on every existing field
purpose: 22 existing configurations chosen to test the taxonomy: each entry carries ONLY the proposed new fields and the real decisions its existing catalog metadata drives. Existing values are never copied here (no parallel source of truth); check-package.mjs reads them from the bound catalog. No fatigue, stimulus or interference number is assigned.

engine.default: REPS when absent (keeps the current bytes)

display.target: app content layer, outside the dose path; copy owner Product/UX writing (DRAFT_FOR_PRODUCT_COPY)

ambiguousAliases.rule: A stiff-legged deadlift is not the Romanian deadlift: an alias that names more than one configuration (or none of them exactly) is asked, never resolved to one (no equivalence by name).
Implement decides convention and comparability (TOTAL vs PER_HAND): asked.
Implement decides convention and skill: asked.
Knee angle and loading change the subpattern and convention: asked.

decisions.rule: HIGH skill: admissible only when declared familiar or reached through the squat ladder (r7b-repertoire.mjs:265)
decisions.outcome: 36 months of training without naming it: goblet-squat instead; named as familiar without a load: selected and established by effort

decisions.rule: HEAVY lower with at least 3 sets is HEAVY for CMP.I02/I05/I10; axial HIGH is the first replaced by a lower-axial same-pattern alternative next to a key run (CMP.P05)
decisions.outcome: Kept away from the day before the quality run when chosen days allow; 2 sets count MODERATE

decisions.rule: TOTAL convention: smallest increment 2.5 kg; LOAD goal: one step every two approved weeks
Not a close variation of goblet-squat (axial and lower differ by more than one step); a dumbbell-only substitute is a different configuration, established by effort
decisions.outcome: substitutesFor(back-squat, dumbbells) = goblet-squat, box-squat-bodyweight; neither is a close variation

decisions.rule: LOW skill, one dumbbell: the default squat MAIN for novices and for anyone whose barbell squat is not declared familiar
decisions.outcome: MAIN SQUAT in scenarios A, B2, F

decisions.rule: SINGLE_IMPLEMENT: the value is the one implement's mass; increment PER_HAND step applied to the one implement
decisions.outcome: Never compared with a barbell load

decisions.rule: MACHINE_STACK: a step is the next setting of that machine, never R plus kilograms (F03B-MACHINE-STEP-r1); never comparable across machines
decisions.outcome: Numberless 'next setting' row; a heavier setting is adopted only when confirmed or repeated

decisions.rule: Same subpattern as back-squat with axial LOW: the lower-axial alternative CMP.P05 can reach for
decisions.outcome: Different stimulus and convention, disclosed; established by effort

display.pt-BR: Agachamento até o banco, peso corporal

decisions.rule: Bodyweight LOW: squat slot with no equipment; second rung of the squat ladder after sit-to-stand
decisions.outcome: Novice without equipment; under a LOAD goal its MAIN row carries BODYWEIGHT_LOWER_STIMULUS

decisions.rule: Standing in for a loaded squat is a different stimulus (stimulusChange), never an equivalent
decisions.outcome: Flagged in substitutesFor

decisions.rule: HEAVY + HIGH eccentric + HIGH axial: CMP.I11 (eccentric before a protected run) and CMP.I02 apply; as MAIN it keeps the essential stimulus the day before the long run
decisions.outcome: Scenario C: kept as MAIN on the day before the long run at 2 sets (counts MODERATE: LOW run cost)

decisions.rule: barbell-rdl -> db-rdl is a directed close variation (skill falls, demands within one step); db-rdl -> barbell-rdl is not (skill rises)
decisions.outcome: No symmetric equivalence

decisions.rule: MODERATE skill, dumbbells: hinge MAIN for intermediates without a declared barbell hinge
decisions.outcome: MAIN HINGE in B2 and F

decisions.rule: HIGH eccentric: a first or re-establishment exposure is never placed by rotation in the session within about a day before the long run (rotationFor)
decisions.outcome: New eccentric leg work stays away from the long run's eve

decisions.rule: HIP_EXTENSION_BRIDGE is an admissible subpattern of the hinge MAIN slot: covers the hinge pattern with no equipment
decisions.outcome: Hinge coverage for bodyweight-only athletes

decisions.rule: BODYWEIGHT: progresses by repetitions only (up to the range top + 4); no added load in V1 (LATER.STR.WEIGHTED_BODYWEIGHT)
decisions.outcome: Reps rise; a loaded hip thrust is reached only through the ladder with agency

decisions.rule: HIGH skill: familiarity-gated like the back squat
decisions.outcome: Selected with its known 60 kg load in scenario B

decisions.rule: Hypertrophy REPS_THEN_LOAD: +2 reps per week inside 8-12, then +2.5 kg and back to 8
Upper body, lower demand NONE: no run-axis cost next to any run
decisions.outcome: Free placement relative to runs

decisions.rule: MODERATE skill with dumbbells and a bench: horizontal push MAIN for intermediates; not tagged RUNNING_SUPPORT, so under that goal push-up outranks it (GAP-S6)
decisions.outcome: MAIN in B2/F; displaced by push-up in C

decisions.rule: PER_HAND convention: the value is each dumbbell; step 2 kg per hand
decisions.outcome: Never summed into a barbell-comparable total

decisions.rule: The only upper push tagged RUNNING_SUPPORT besides incline push-up: the purpose criterion ranks before external loading
decisions.outcome: MAIN horizontal push for a RUNNING_SUPPORT athlete with a full gym (GAP-S6; SQ-2 proposes loaded first for UPPER slots)

decisions.rule: Ladder wall-pushup -> incline-push-up -> push-up -> pike-push-up; the last link changes subpattern (a variation, not a progression)
decisions.outcome: Novice path without equipment

decisions.rule: VERTICAL_PUSH is admissible in the push MAIN slots, but the slot default subpattern HORIZONTAL_PUSH always wins while a horizontal configuration is admissible
decisions.outcome: Never selected in 12 weeks for full-gym, machine or dumbbell-and-bench profiles (GAP-S8); N4 makes the second push MAIN slot of the week prefer it, fixed for the block

decisions.rule: LOW skill, dumbbells: the horizontal pull MAIN for dumbbell profiles
decisions.outcome: MAIN PULL in A, B2, D

decisions.rule: A band or bodyweight stand-in is a different stimulus
decisions.outcome: substitutesFor(db-row, no equipment) flags every result

decisions.rule: BAND_TENSION: an athlete-reported ordinal level, never kilograms; progresses by repetitions, the harder level is the athlete's choice
decisions.outcome: No kilogram ever stated

decisions.rule: Tagged RUNNING_SUPPORT: outranks db-row and seated-cable-row under that goal even with a full gym
decisions.outcome: MAIN PULL in scenario C (GAP-S6)

decisions.rule: VERTICAL_PULL at LOW skill: the vertical pull for anyone with machines while the pull-up is not reached; today the horizontal default subpattern always wins the pull MAIN slots
decisions.outcome: Never selected in 12 weeks even with machines (GAP-S8); N4 would place it in the second pull MAIN slot

decisions.rule: MACHINE_STACK next-setting rule
decisions.outcome: Numberless step

decisions.rule: HIGH skill, ladder scapular-pull-up -> band-assisted-pull-up -> pull-up; reached only with agency at a block boundary after ADVANCE/EARNED exposures
decisions.outcome: Never assumed from training age

decisions.rule: SKILL_MISMATCH goes one rung down (band-assisted-pull-up), never up
decisions.outcome: Regression along the chain only

decisions.rule: HIGH eccentric lower: as a non-MAIN row in a session within about a day before the long run under a RUN lead it loses one set, disclosed (CMP.P04)
decisions.outcome: Content reduction instead of moving the long run

decisions.rule: UNILATERAL: reps per side; a set counts once per side, sides never summed
decisions.outcome: Instruction 'repetitions are per side'

decisions.rule: STEP and SPLIT_STANCE share a rotation group: an admissible LUNGE alternative with LOW eccentric
decisions.outcome: The rotation alternative that never raises eccentric demand

decisions.rule: CALF rows count at most LIGHT lower demand (r6-balanced.mjs:24): no key-run cost
decisions.outcome: Calf work can sit next to a run

decisions.rule: STRAIGHT_KNEE default; under RUNNING_SUPPORT or an event, calf slots alternate with bent-knee, at most half bent-knee
decisions.outcome: Gastrocnemius-biased by default

decisions.rule: BENT_KNEE (soleus emphasis) only by the goal-context alternation, never more than half the calf slots
decisions.outcome: Instruction: 'a variation, not a better exercise'

decisions.rule: ANTI_EXTENSION default trunk subpattern; repetition-based stability work
decisions.outcome: The trunk row in A, B, C, F

decisions.rule: An isometric hold: the current row model prescribes it as '1x12 reps @RIR3' and progresses it to 14 'reps' (GAP-S2)
decisions.outcome: SI-V1-SSCTR-SQ-1 (a) approved with conditions: not admissible anywhere (slots, rotation, substitution, fallback, ladder offer from dead-bug) while no time dose is approved; dead-bug, bird-dog and pallof-press keep the trunk covered

decisions.rule: An isometric hold, UNILATERAL (per side), ANTI_LATERAL_FLEXION: the current row model has no time dose (GAP-S2)
decisions.outcome: SI-V1-SSCTR-SQ-1: not admissible for selection while no time dose is approved; the loss of anti-lateral-flexion coverage is disclosed as a known limitation

decisions.outcome: Purpose is context, never a claim (FORBIDDEN_CLAIM guard in r6-prescription.mjs)
